label: Main loop and remainder
subgoals: Divide the trip count by the unroll factor for the main trips
Take the trip count modulo the factor for the remainder
Guard or peel the remainder when the trip count is unknown

label: Cycles under resource limits
subgoals: Multiply per-iteration operation counts by U
Take the maximum of depth and each resource bound
Multiply by the number of unrolled trips

label: Where unrolling stops paying
subgoals: Bound U by depth times units divided by operations for each type
Take the smallest bound as the useful unroll limit
Check memory ports and recurrences before unrolling further
